pinout.title: Physical Wiring (Pico → P7501)
pinout.line1: • P7501 Connector (UART 115200 8N1): Official GND is PIN 4; keep GP3 / NSW5V (Pin 5) strictly as Hi-Z input (~3.29V idle; IC1506 rail ~5.15V — NEVER drive push-pull).
pinout.line2: • XRESET (Pin 2 / GP5): Drive strictly in Open-Drain.
pinout.line3: Always verify 0.0Ω continuity beep with a multimeter before powering on!
pinout.empty: No P7501 pins mapped in SSOT.

bridge.title: Interactive SC0 Bridge, WAITTX & Optical Drive Console
bridge.subtitle: Live bidirectional USB-CDC <-> SC0 passthrough (exit with '~~~'), PANA_RSP probe (0x15/$g/$Z0), and drive serial CLI
bridge.driveSection: Optical Drive Service CLI (F/E PCB UART 0xB002/0xB004 — not P7501/ATAPI)
bridge.inputPlaceholder: F/E drive cmd (PASS 0x4d415453 0x48495441, START, LDD), hex (15 / 0E0402), or RSP (g, Z0, m515B2E38,10)...
bridge.emptyStream: No SC0 Bridge session running. Start the bridge for live passthrough or use the quick triggers above.
bridge.busArchitectureTitle: Two-Bus Physical Architecture (E05 IPL RO / Safe NVRAM+RAM RW)
bridge.busArchitectureSummary: SC0 UART (P7501) <-> BOOT.BIN / MAIN (_dev_SERIAL RSP ///) <-> ATAPI 0x880000C0; separately, the 113 DRV CLI commands (DRVPANA auto PASS 0x4d415453 0x48495441 unlock) reside on the F/E Drive PCB UART (0xB002..0xB004). IPL NOR writes remain blocked (E05); SRAM/NVRAM writes are guarded.
bridge.bgoHaltWarningTitle: BOOT.BIN halted on BGO driver init failed (boot_panic_or_halt_7812)
bridge.bgoHaltWarningBody: FUN_4400836f (bgo_driver_init) failed in NORMAL mode before fmu_sd_dispatcher(1), so MAIN and _dev_SERIAL (PANARSP) are not running in this session.
